source.name: Rafale ajustée du M41A de Ripley
source.sourceWork: Aliens (1986), Ellen Ripley before the power-loader fight
source.appearance: Short curly brown hair; grey-blue civilian work clothes; two-handed M41A pulse rifle; no power loader or later-film costume.

source.name: Tir de couverture du M41A de Hicks
source.sourceWork: Aliens (1986), Corporal Dwayne Hicks in colonial marine field armour
source.appearance: Colonial Marine green-brown camouflage armour, short brown hair, M41A pulse rifle, optional helmet retained consistently; no acid damage.

source.name: Vérification de sécurité de Bishop
source.sourceWork: Aliens (1986), Bishop before his injury
source.appearance: Adult android with short fair hair and pale grey-white technician coveralls; intact body and empty hands, no knife game or invented gun.

source.name: Consigne de repli de Dallas
source.sourceWork: Alien (1979), Captain Arthur Dallas before entering the ventilation ducts
source.appearance: Bearded adult Nostromo captain in dark blue work jacket, practical crew trousers; empty hands, no later marine armour.

source.name: Organisation du passage par Parker
source.sourceWork: Alien (1979), Dennis Parker aboard the Nostromo
source.appearance: Adult Black chief engineer with dark short hair, light work shirt and dark utility trousers; empty hands, no invented powered gauntlet.

source.name: Indication de route de Lambert
source.sourceWork: Alien (1979), Joan Lambert aboard the Nostromo
source.appearance: Adult navigator with short brown hair, practical Nostromo work shirt and trousers; empty hands, no marine rifle, no supernatural panic attack.

source.name: Lecture du protocole par Ash
source.sourceWork: Alien (1979), Ash in his intact science-officer form
source.appearance: Intact adult android science officer, neatly combed brown hair, pale long-sleeve science shirt and cream trousers; no disassembly or improvised attack.

source.name: Frappe de la clé de maintenance d’Amanda
source.sourceWork: Alien: Isolation (2014), adult Amanda Ripley aboard Sevastopol
source.appearance: Adult woman with brown hair tied back, practical brown-grey work jacket and dark utility trousers; Sevastopol maintenance jack held as a physical tool.

source.name: Repérage de passage de Chell
source.sourceWork: Portal 2 (2011), adult Chell in the test chambers
source.appearance: Adult Chell with ponytail, white Aperture tank top, orange jumpsuit tied at waist, long-fall boots and dual-prong portal device. No device used as a damaging laser.

source.name: Coordination de test d’ATLAS
source.sourceWork: Portal 2 (2011), ATLAS cooperative testing robot
source.appearance: Short spherical white-grey ATLAS robot, one blue optic, thin mechanical arms and legs, portal device. No P-Body silhouette or offensive portal beam.

source.name: Coordination de test de P-Body
source.sourceWork: Portal 2 (2011), P-Body cooperative testing robot
source.appearance: Tall narrow white-grey P-Body robot, single orange optic, long thin mechanical limbs, portal device. No ATLAS proportions or weapon damage.

source.name: Consigne de test de GLaDOS
source.sourceWork: Portal 2 (2011), GLaDOS in her central chamber chassis
source.appearance: White segmented suspended chamber chassis, black mechanical support cables, single yellow optic. Fixed suspended silhouette; do not invent humanoid legs, a gun or magical flight.

source.name: Avertissement de Wheatley
source.sourceWork: Portal 2 (2011), portable Wheatley intelligence core before the chassis transfer
source.appearance: Small spherical white-black intelligence core with one blue optic and two handles; portable core presentation, no human body, giant GLaDOS chassis or invented weapon.

source.name: Indication du passage de Rattmann
source.sourceWork: Portal 2: Lab Rat (2011), adult Doug Rattmann
source.appearance: Adult unshaven Aperture employee with untidy brown hair and worn laboratory clothing, portable companion cube allowed as a carried object only; no invented portal-gun combat.

source.name: Repli prudent de Rincewind
source.sourceWork: The Colour of Magic (1983), adult Rincewind
source.appearance: Thin adult wizard in battered red robe and pointed red hat marked WIZZARD, practical boots; empty hands and anxious retreat. No reliable combat magic or invented staff.

source.name: Frappe de l’épée de Vimes
source.sourceWork: Guards! Guards! (1989), Captain Sam Vimes of the Night Watch
source.appearance: Weathered adult Night Watch captain, worn breastplate over brown clothing, battered watch helmet, practical short sword. No royal-regalia outfit or supernatural law aura.

source.name: Consigne ferme de Mémé Ciredutemps
source.sourceWork: Wyrd Sisters (1988), Granny Esme Weatherwax
source.appearance: Older woman in severe plain black dress and tall black pointed witch hat, thin upright posture, empty hands. Headology represented by grounded guidance, not magical shields or fireballs.

source.name: Repérage touristique de Deuxfleurs
source.sourceWork: The Colour of Magic (1983), adult Twoflower
source.appearance: Adult Agatean tourist with glasses, bright patterned tourist shirt, practical trousers and luggage strap; nonoffensive observation. No damaging camera flash or invented firearm.

source.name: Balayage physique de la faux de la Mort
source.sourceWork: Mort (1987), Death in his ordinary robed manifestation
source.appearance: Tall complete skeleton in black hooded robe, blue eye lights and long wooden-handled scythe. Physical bounded blade contact only; no instant soul removal or guaranteed kill.

source.name: Rassemblement de Nounou Ogg
source.sourceWork: Wyrd Sisters (1988), Nanny Gytha Ogg
source.appearance: Short sturdy older witch, cheerful round face, plain black dress and practical black hat, empty hands. No invented attack spell, enchanted bottle or damaging song.

source.name: Tir ajusté du Desert Eagle de Meryl
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998), Meryl Silverburgh at Shadow Moses
source.appearance: Short red hair and burgundy headband, olive sleeveless top, grey cargo trousers, black boots, physical Desert Eagle handgun.

source.name: Enchaînement rapproché de Liquid
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998), Liquid Snake at Shadow Moses
source.appearance: Adult blond man, long open tan military coat, black combat trousers, dark boots and gloves. Bare-chest source costume stays nonsexual; unarmed physical strikes, no REX beam.

source.name: Prise de CQC de The Boss
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004), The Boss during Operation Snake Eater (1964)
source.appearance: Adult blonde woman in white-grey sneaking suit with front fastened, dark gloves and boots. Physical close-quarters grapple, no Volgin electricity or later-era equipment.

source.name: Tir ajusté du revolver d’Ocelot
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998), Revolver Ocelot before losing his hand
source.appearance: Adult older man with long grey hair and moustache, brown duster, red scarf, black gloves and intact hands; Colt Single Action Army revolver.

source.name: Taille du katana de Gray Fox
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid (1998), Gray Fox in the Cyborg Ninja exoskeleton
source.appearance: Enclosed blue-grey and orange Cyborg Ninja suit with red central eye sensor, physical straight katana. No exposed damaged body or Raiden costume.

source.name: Tir du M1911A1 de Naked Snake
source.sourceWork: Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater (2004), Naked Snake after acquiring the right-eye patch
source.appearance: Adult dark-haired Naked Snake, green bandana, right-eye patch, olive jungle fatigues, combat webbing and boots, physical suppressed M1911A1. No Venom Snake prosthetic or horn.

source.name: Enchaînement au sabre vert de Luke
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (1983), adult Luke Skywalker aboard the second Death Star
source.appearance: Adult Luke with short brown hair, black Jedi outfit, black right glove and green lightsaber. No blue blade, sequel costume or ranged Force lightning.

source.name: Taille au sabre rouge de Vador
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1980), Darth Vader at Bespin
source.appearance: Black helmet and armour, chest control box, black cape, red lightsaber. Mechanical breathing stance; no unmasked injury, Force choke or fabricated lightning.

hero.name: Ahsoka Tano (Adult)
hero.incarnation: Rebels and Ahsoka - mature former Jedi

source.name: Croisement des deux sabres blancs d’Ahsoka
source.sourceWork: Star Wars Rebels, season 2 (2015–2016), adult Ahsoka Tano
source.appearance: Adult orange-skinned Togruta with white face markings, long blue-white lekku and montrals, grey-blue practical outfit and two white lightsabers. No teenage Clone Wars outfit.

source.name: Taille au sabre bleu d’Aayla
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (2005), adult Jedi Aayla Secura
source.appearance: Adult blue Twi’lek Jedi with two long blue lekku and brown headwrap, brown Jedi field outfit, blue lightsaber. Source clothing framed nonsexually as ordinary field gear.

hero.name: Darth Revan
hero.incarnation: Knights of the Old Republic iconic masked identity

source.name: Taille au sabre rouge de Revan
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2003), masked Darth Revan in the selected dark-side armour
source.appearance: Masked adult Revan in red-brown and dark armour, black hood and cloak, one red lightsaber. No player-customized face, purple offhand blade or unrelated MMO armour.

source.name: Contre au sabre bleu d’Obi-Wan
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (2005), adult Obi-Wan Kenobi
source.appearance: Adult bearded Obi-Wan with short auburn hair, cream Jedi tunic, brown belt and tall boots, blue lightsaber. No Alec Guinness older continuity or blaster.

source.name: Enchaînement au sabre vert de Yoda
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: Attack of the Clones (2002), Yoda in his Jedi field robes
source.appearance: Small elderly green Jedi with large ears, cream robe over brown tunic, short green lightsaber. Native small stature, no human proportions or invented lightning.

hero.name: Darth Maul
hero.incarnation: The Clone Wars - ruler of Mandalore

source.name: Balayage du double sabre de Maul
source.sourceWork: Star Wars: The Phantom Menace (1999), Darth Maul before his defeat on Naboo
source.appearance: Adult red-black tattooed Zabrak with small horns, black layered robes and boots, double-ended red lightsaber. Intact original legs, no mechanical limbs.

source.name: Tir ajusté du revolver de Joel
source.sourceWork: The Last of Us (2013), adult Joel during the autumn journey
source.appearance: Adult bearded Joel, brown-green plaid work shirt, dark jeans, boots and worn backpack, physical revolver. No infected abilities or later severe injury.

source.name: Tir de couverture du pistolet de Tess
source.sourceWork: The Last of Us (2013), adult Tess before the Capitol encounter
source.appearance: Adult Tess with brown hair tied back, burgundy-red short-sleeve work shirt, dark trousers and boots, ordinary handgun. No infection imagery or magical support.

source.name: Tir du fusil de Tommy
source.sourceWork: The Last of Us (2013), adult Tommy at Jackson hydroelectric dam
source.appearance: Adult Tommy with medium brown hair and facial hair, practical brown work jacket and jeans, two-handed physical hunting rifle. No later eye injury.

source.name: Tir de couverture de Dina
source.sourceWork: The Last of Us Part II (2020), adult Dina on the early Seattle journey
source.appearance: Adult Dina, dark hair tied back, grey-green hooded field jacket and dark trousers, backpack, ordinary handgun. No pregnancy imagery or child version.

source.name: Tir ajusté du pistolet d’Abby
source.sourceWork: The Last of Us Part II (2020), adult Abby on Seattle day one
source.appearance: Adult athletic Abby with blonde braid, grey sleeveless work shirt, dark tactical trousers and backpack, ordinary military handgun. No later captivity appearance or weapon invented from injury.

source.name: Consigne d’évacuation de Hayden
source.sourceWork: DOOM (2016), Samuel Hayden in his intact robotic body
source.appearance: Tall intact white-grey robotic director body, broad mechanical shoulders, compact head and luminous face optic. No DOOM Eternal dismembered form, Crucible or invented arm cannon.
